title: Natural scalar-forgetting comparison at the top open
statement: Let X be any ringed space and p a natural number. The functor H^p(X,-) valued in modules over the ring of global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], followed by forgetting scalars to abelian groups, is naturally isomorphic to the open module cohomology functor at the top open [def-sc-open-module-cohomology]. No compactness or nonemptiness assumption is required.

source.place: Tag 01DZ, cohomology-modules; Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.ShortComplex.PreservesHomology, ShortComplex.homologyFunctorIso; Mathlib.Algebra.Homology.HomotopyCategory, homologyFunctorFactors and mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso.

proof.text: Global sections followed by forgetting scalars equals top-open sections. Exact scalar forgetting commutes naturally with homology via ShortComplex.homologyFunctorIso. Lift that comparison to the homotopy category with Quotient.natIsoLift and the homologyFunctorFactors comparisons.

Whisker the comparison by global sections on complexes and by the injective-resolution functor. Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryCompIso identifies the composite section functor. This gives the displayed natural isomorphism, including degree zero.
